source_truth_generator: original PR52 EntityTruthBranch and BusinessSimulator; new seeds, same scenario family
source_previous_heldout: PR52 48 blind test cases and PR50 24 cases already disclosed, strictly excluded from this protocol's training and validation
node_scope: Only currently PUBLIC robots/tasks/stations/resources; previously nonexistent future job IDs never features, anonymous new-task event count only
score_rule: maximize predicted H20 completed stages = sum predicted public current task completed probabilities + predicted completed future newly visible stages; NO trainable ranker
architecture: same PyG RGCNConv hidden48 two-layer node+event heads as frozen PR52; consistent arms apply task status simplex and constrain anonymous completed new stages <= new visible count
validation_selection: mean of 3 seeds per arm: require entity MSE and station device Brier <=1.15x consistent_pred_only validation; among eligible choose lower real counterfactual regret, tie lower entity MSE; immutable before TEST read
tests: near-tied top2 score margin fraction under 1e-5
original H20 score no Q head
method_caveat: Pairwise future-state contrast loss is a proposed application-specific supervision component using real same-prefix simulated outcomes, not claimed as established VaGraM/GNS formula. GNS relation message-passing and calibrated VAML guide representation/checks.
no_go: Do not use old PR52 test to tune architecture or weights; new heldout one-shot; no claim full autoregressive world simulator or fully online business performance.
